description: FAIRiCUBE provides a 100-metre Vienna building-volume indicator as one small public GeoTIFF under CC BY 4.0. The provider defines the underlying quantity as building footprint multiplied by average building height, then normalises the map to a range from zero to one. It can represent relative built-form intensity in an urban-heat, exposure or district energy scenario. The raster does not carry cubic metres of physical volume after normalisation, and the public page does not identify a reference year, source building inventory or normalisation denominator. It should therefore not be used to calculate actual floor area, energy load or material tonnage without separate inputs. The file is a city-scale contextual layer, not an individual building model. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Vienna indicator. Its GeoTIFF was not downloaded, so cell alignment, projection, values and coverage were not independently verified.
